newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Sport-Sri Lanka win toss, NZ bat in one-dayer.
newsitem.headline: NZ Sport-Sri Lanka win toss, NZ bat in one-dayer.

text.p: Sri Lanka, looking to salvage some pride from a dismal tour, won the toss and asked New Zealand to bat in their day-night limited overs international on Tuesday.
Sri Lanka, the world one-day champions, lost both tests earlier in the summer and were further frustrated when the first scheduled one-day contest was lost to rain at the weekend.
Three players were making their one-day international debuts -- batsman Matt Horne and left-arm spinner Daniel Vettori for New Zealand, and seam bowler Nuwan Zoysa for the tourists.
Vettori owed his elevation to the withdrawal from the team last night of experienced offspinner Dipak Patel, who sprained his ankle during training.
New Zealand: Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Chris Harris, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull, Heath Davis, Daniel Vettori.

Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Roshan Mahanama, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekaratne, Upul Chandana, Kumar Dharmasena, Chaminda Vaas, Muttiah Muralitharan, Nuwan Zoysa.
